title: Derived graded modules
summary: We introduce the notion of the $\infty$-category of (complete) derived $G$-graded modules over a $G$-graded ring $R$ for a torsion-free abelian group $G$, and we study its foundational properties. Moreover, we prove a categorical equivalence between (complete) derived $G$-graded modules over $R$ and derived (formal) comodules over a certain comonad constructed from the group ring $R[G]$ of $G$ over $R$.
